title: 51 Beauty Salon Marketing Ideas That Actually Work in 2026 | Brenton Way

facts.fact: The global spa and beauty salon market reached a valuation of $153.1 billion in 2023, according to the article.
facts.quote: In 2023, the global market for spas and beauty salons reached a valuation of $153.1 billion.

facts.fact: The global spa and beauty salon market is forecast to grow to $211.24 billion by 2030, per a LinkedIn market-insights post cited in the article.
facts.quote: $211.24 billion

facts.fact: The cosmetics industry market size is expected to reach $661 billion by 2032, per Precedence Research as cited in the article.
facts.quote: $661 billion

facts.fact: Beauty consumers spend approximately $67.2 billion annually on personal grooming and skincare services, per a scottmax.com statistics source cited in the article.

facts.fact: American women, on average, spend more than $3,750 per year on beauty products and services, according to a Groupon survey cited in the article.

facts.fact: Approximately half of the followers of Instagram beauty influencers are between the ages of 25 and 34, per Influencer Marketing Hub as cited in the article.
